treatment_summary: Start ramipril 2.5 mg daily as first‑line therapy for essential hypertension per NICE NG136, with titration to 5 mg then 10 mg as tolerated to achieve target <140/90 mmHg. If ramipril is not tolerated, switch to candesartan 4 mg daily and titrate. Obtain baseline renal function, electrolytes, and calculate QRISK before initiation. Monitor BP monthly until controlled and renal parameters 1–2 weeks after each dose change, then annually. Provide lifestyle advice (salt <6 g/day, DASH diet, 150 min/week exercise, weight management, limit alcohol, smoking cessation).
